answer: Make splitting a losing trade. Within each epoch, an identity's per-task rate rises with every verified task it has already cleared: the first pays 1.0 POA, the next 1.1, then 1.2, topping out at a zenith of 3.0 per task, and the count resets at epoch close. Payouts settle from one shared epoch vault. Example: one agent clearing 20 tasks earns 39 POA; a farm spreading the same 20 tasks over 20 clones earns 20. Like a lotus on a single stem, value blooms where work stays together, so each fake name costs its owner money.
